attributes.title: NCAMFT 2027 Annual Conference: Alone Together
attributes.series: NCAMFT Annual Conference (North Carolina Association for Marriage and Family Therapy)
attributes.organizer: North Carolina Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
attributes.summary:
The North Carolina Association for Marriage and Family Therapy holds its 2027 annual conference from March 18 to 20, 2027, in Raleigh, with an online option that includes live and recorded sessions. The theme is "Alone Together: Rediscovering Belonging and Connection," a fitting topic for relational therapists working with isolation, loneliness and disconnection in couples and families.

The conference is the state's main yearly gathering for licensed marriage and family therapists, associates and students, and the hybrid format lets clinicians from across North Carolina attend without travel. The association also runs online CE programs and keeps a directory of approved supervisors.

So far NCAMFT has published only the dates, theme, city and format. The venue, fees and number of CE hours had not been posted when we checked in November 2026. LMFTs who need hours for renewal should watch the conference page for the CE statement before registering.
